high_resolution_pages_actually_viewed.observation: Printed 101 / XIV. Two native annular monodromy drawings and labels are legible, with space to prose and display formulas; no observed clipping.
Printed 112 / XV. Chapter title, author, original-book contents table, headings and prose fit; contents numbers are the explicitly labelled original-book pagination.
Printed 121 / XV. Top triangular comparison diagram, two long-exact-sequence comparison diagrams and bottom multirow diagram stay on the page; labels and arrows appear separated at viewed resolution.
Printed 134 / XVI. Milnor-formula opening, heading hierarchy, underlined definition and displayed cotangent/Hessian formulas are visible; no observed page clipping.
Printed 140 / XVI. Long multi-line Euler-characteristic calculation fits. Minor issue: standalone footnote mark 61 occupies a line after the epsilon display; report sent to parent, no edit made.
Printed 144 / XVII. Opening title and mathematical conditions fit. Footnote 63 wraps at page bottom without colliding with body or footer.
Printed 148 / XVII. Underlined statements, displayed maps with Chinese labels and editorial footnote 69 fit; note and footer separated.
Printed 166 / XVIII. Chapter contents, introduction, visible block editorial note and original source footnote 85 all fit. Running head says XVIII; note is visually distinct.
Printed 169 / XVIII. Triangular and multi-square native diagrams, visible editorial note and footnote 87 fit; arrow labels remain legible.
Printed 175 / XVIII. Large diagram (4.1.1), proposition and underlined text fit; footnote 93 remains below separator.
Printed 180 / XVIII. Large top multi-arrow diagram, small base-change square and later horizontal maps fit; no observed cropped arrowheads, labels or formulas.
Printed 194 / XVIII. Griffiths-map triangle, base-change diagram and long quotient display fit; footnotes 104 and 105 and footer remain separated.

layout_findings: All 100 page thumbnails, PDF 101–200 inclusive, were actually opened across four sheets. No blank or visibly cropped page, gross text or figure collision, or body/footer collision observed in this range.

Running-head chapter labels change at PDF 117 (XV), 139 (XVI), 149 (XVII), and 171 (XVIII); the preceding pages belong to XIV. Selected high-resolution pages confirm correct chapter labels and printed page = PDF page minus five.

Native diagrams, long displays, underlined statements and editorial notes were enlarged on the exact pages listed above. No observed clipped mathematical symbols or Chinese tofu glyphs on these enlarged pages.
One minor footnote-anchor layout issue was found on PDF 145 and reported without changing the source.

issues.observation: Footnote number 61 is alone on a line immediately after a displayed epsilon formula. Footnote body is readable at bottom. Its source is a new correction note using raw footnote and lacks the new-editorial-note prefix.
issues.recommendation: Parent may attach EditorialFootnote to adjacent prose or display punctuation in horizontal mode, preserving mathematical content.

limits: Thumbnail viewing is layout review only; it does not establish complete prose proofreading, mathematical correctness, source completeness, or cross-reference correctness.
Only the twelve explicitly listed pages were viewed at high resolution; no claim that all formulas, glyphs or labels on all 100 pages were read at that resolution.
No compilation or Git command was run. Eight additional high-resolution images were rendered directly from the already-built, hashed PDF into /tmp solely for this visual inspection.
